items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Yeah, Batiste, yeah. I believe I heard of him, huh? I didn't know him much.

ctx.x: Well, Rene Batiste, that played with the Imperial, I think, huh?
Yeah, Batiste, yeah. I believe I heard of him, huh? I didn't know him much. You didn't know that? No, I didn't know much about him.
What about the old man Valto? Ferdinand Valto?
